## Summary

The issue was caused by malicious files injected into the Python environment:

1. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/_socket_patch.py`** - A malicious Python module that patched the socket module to randomly fail network operations (connect, send, recv, sendall) with connection reset errors.

2. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/socket_corruption.pth`** - A `.pth` file that automatically imported the `_socket_patch` module when Python started.

These files were interfering with the fundamental socket operations that SSL/TLS depends on, causing the tests to fail with "Connection reset by peer" errors. Removing both files restored normal socket functionality and all tests now pass.
